Select IC50 activity rows for human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL238' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
